#include <cmath>
#include <climits>
using namespace std;
#define ll long long int
int main()
{
	ll x, y, n, i, j, a = LLONG_MIN, b;
	cin >> x >> y >> n;
	for (i = 1; i <= n; i++)
	{
		ll k = i * x / y;
		if (i * x - k * y > (k + 1) * y - i * x) k++;
		if ((a == LLONG_MIN) || abs(k * y - i * x) * b < abs(a * y - b * x) * i)
			a = k, b = i;
	}
	cout << a << "/" << b << endl;
}
